intent: To illustrate how the presence of peacekeepers significantly reduces the likelihood of war reoccurring during the period 1989-2004.

requirements.question: Must the video state the 24% likelihood, or can it omit the exact value?
Are all data marks declared by G0 present in the required state or states?

units.claim: The likelihood of war reoccurring is 24%.
units.evidence: A visible numeral 24% (or 24 percent) is shown as the likelihood of war reoccurring.

units.claim: All 1 required bar marks or stacked segments appear in the final chart.
accept: all 1 required data marks are visible
the complete required mark set is present in the final chart
reject: omitting any required bar or stacked segment
replacing missing marks with a summary total or subtitle
units.evidence: G0 data-row coverage is rendered as a complete set of identifiable bar marks.

optional_valid: The video may note that war recurrence is not eliminated; a 24% likelihood remains.
The video may frame the value as about a quarter, as in the narration.
The video may include the historical period as context, but it is not a table data value.

clip_hardcase.reason: The reference SVG has no explicit data-role=bar mark, so visual-unit reconstruction needs manual review.

hardcases.handling: Requires human visual inspection before semantic scoring.
